degree_ledger.closed_here: only the bookkeeping shape is fixed; the nonzero rank lemma is still the bottleneck
degree_ledger.parameter_shape: take D,T on the P^(1/2) scale after the rank lemma supplies a nonzero auxiliary function
degree_ledger.pole_budget: auxiliary functions have pole divisor degree O_m(D)
degree_ledger.zero_budget: multipity T at N selected points forces at least T*N zeros

normalized_problem.already_closed: Burgess kernel formula, d-th-power criterion, exceptional diagonal, Kummer conductor ledger
normalized_problem.branch_count: m=|{places where ord_a(f) not congruent to 0 mod d}| <= 2r
normalized_problem.constant_discipline: C_m may depend on fixed m but not on d, P, chi, or the root positions
normalized_problem.input: P prime, nonprincipal chi, f in F_P(x), f not a d-th power for d=ord(chi)

plain_conclusion: 秩一 Kummer 迹界的初等内部化路线继续缩窄为 Stepanov 辅助多项式的秩/非零问题。本步已经把目标标准化为分支数 `m<=2r` 的阶无关平方根界，并把 Stepanov 路线拆成六包：值类放大、辅助空间、插值条件、秩非零、重数-次数矛盾、参数优化。其中值类接口、重数-次数账本和常数不依赖角色阶 `d` 的纪律已经固定。唯一真正剩余不再是笼统 Weil/RH，而是 `StepanovKummerAuxiliaryPolynomialNonzeroRankSurjectivity`：必须证明所选辅助函数空间在 Kummer 关系与导数条件下仍有足够非零秩。未证明该秩引理前，作者侧不能声明 Kummer 迹界、Weil 界、B4 或行/列命题无条件闭合。

rank_gap.forbidden_shortcut: do not count all monomials on y^d=f(x) with d-dependent dimension; this reintroduces the forbidden character-order dependence
rank_gap.needed_statement: for every non-dth-power f with m branch places, there is a Stepanov auxiliary space of dimension > imposed conditions and rank loss O_m(1)
rank_gap.why_it_is_the_real_gap: dimension counting alone is not enough; the chosen auxiliary functions must remain nonzero after Kummer/eigenspace relations and derivative conditions

rows.meaning: 上一证书已把唯一剩余压成秩一 Kummer RH/Stepanov 迹界。
目标已标准化为分支数 `m<=2r`、常数只依赖 m 的乘法角色和平方根界。
Stepanov 路线已拆成值类放大、辅助空间、插值条件、秩非零、重数-次数和参数优化六包。
若角色和超过 `C_m P^(1/2)`，可转成某个 Kummer 值类的过量点集。
一旦存在非零辅助函数，重数-次数矛盾账本给出平方根级阈值。
参数只允许依赖分支数 m，已排除角色阶 d 进入常数。
仍需证明辅助函数空间在 Kummer 关系和导数条件下有足够非零秩。
Stepanov 完整证明等待秩/非零引理。
秩一 Kummer 迹界作者侧仍未完全内部化。
有理函数 Weil 界等待 Kummer/Stepanov 迹界内部化。
B4 仍等待 Weil/Kummer/Stepanov 终端输入；接受外部定理时可关闭。
本步只关闭 Stepanov 路线的精确拆包和参数边界，不声明行/列命题无条件闭合。

stepanov_packages.S1_value_class_amplification: large character-sum bias forces one coset/value class of the Kummer torsor to contain P/d + Omega(P^(1/2)) excess after a standard Fourier inversion
stepanov_packages.S2_auxiliary_space: choose an auxiliary function space on P^1 with poles only at the branch divisor B and bounded order depending on m
stepanov_packages.S3_interpolation_conditions: impose vanishing to multiplicity T at every point in the overlarge value class
stepanov_packages.S4_nonzero_rank_surjectivity: prove the interpolation map has a nonzero kernel element not identically zero on the Kummer eigenspace
stepanov_packages.S5_degree_multiplicity_contradiction: a nonzero auxiliary function cannot have more forced zeros than its pole degree permits
stepanov_packages.S6_parameter_optimization: choose degree and multiplicity parameters so the contradiction starts at excess > C_m P^(1/2)
